description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'ViewOrganizationGeneralInformationController' within the OrangeHRM HRM system. The class extends an abstract Vue controller and is responsible for preparing data (such as number of employees and country list) for rendering the organization general information view in the frontend. It uses traits and services for retrieving employee count and country data and constructs a Vue component with properties for display.

classes.name: ViewOrganizationGeneralInformationController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for preparing organization info for the view, including employee count and country list, rendered as a Vue component.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data and Vue component for rendering the organization general information page.
